_doc: USD per million tokens, used only for local CLI sessions (cloud sessions report their own list-price cost). Fitted on 2026-10-17 from 29 cloud sessions' modelUsage costUSD (weighted least squares, within about 2% on most sessions). out_mult and out_per_call estimate output tokens from a message's visible text and tool input (chars / 3.5), since the transcript's per-message output_tokens is only a stream-start snapshot; calibrated on one cloud session where the exact output was known.
